subject: SLA & Support Onboarding — initial checklist and escalation contacts
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA & Support Onboarding — initial checklist and escalation contacts

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference rollout. Procurement asked that we run a short SLA/support onboarding so your IT and ops teams have the right contacts and escalation paths documented before we enable dedicated capacity. Can you please fill out the items below and return by end of week? If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call to go through this together.

Requested items (short answers ok):
- Primary support contact (name, role, email, phone)
- Secondary support contact
- On-call escalation path (pager/email/phone; who to contact at severity P1/P2)
- Target uptime/SLO you expect us to support (per-region if applicable)
- Maintenance window constraints and blackout dates
- Preferred SLAs for response and resolution (e.g., 15 min ack / 2 hr P1 response)
- Any SOC2/incident reporting coordination contacts
- Compliance or data residency requirements that affect monitoring/alerts

We have attached our onboarding checklist template to make it quicker — fill and return or paste answers directly into a reply.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_SLA_Template_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-retail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SLA & Support Onboarding — initial checklist and escalation contacts

Rishi —

Appreciate the checklist. See answers inline below and attached a filled copy of your template (ACME_SLA_Responses_20260302.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call Thursday if you need more detail.

- Primary support contact: Daniel Park, Head of Cloud Ops, daniel.park@acme-retail.com, +1-617-555-0182
- Secondary contact: Priya Rao, Platform Engineer, priya.rao@acme-retail.com, +1-617-555-0199
- On-call escalation path: P1 -> Direct phone to Daniel (call & SMS) -> 15-min ack; P2 -> Email to ops@acme-retail.com, 1 hr ack; P3 -> Ticket queue
- Target uptime/SLO: 99.95% monthly in us-east-1; regional redundancy required for payment flows
- Maintenance windows: Prefer 02:00–05:00 local (EST) weekly; blackout for end-of-month close (last 3 days of month)
- Preferred SLA: P1: 15 min ack / 2 hr high-touch response; P2: 1 hr ack / 8 hr response
- SOC2/contact: Compliance inbox compliance@acme-retail.com; security contact: maya.srinivasan@acme-retail.com
- Data residency: Primary data and logs must remain in us-east-1; anonymized telemetry may be stored elsewhere with notice

We note you list standard maintenance ahead of time; please provide a schedule of planned maintenance windows in advance (48 hours preferred).

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Cloud Operations | Acme Retail

Attachment: ACME_SLA_Responses_20260302.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SLA & Support Onboarding — initial checklist and escalation contacts

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Daniel — this is very helpful. A couple of follow-ups I want to capture so procurement has the right artifacts for vendor setup: 

1) Can you confirm the phone escalation for P1 should also go to a 24/7 paging service or is Daniel the single point for after-hours? (Procurement sometimes asks for a secondary 24/7 pager)
2) For the 99.95% SLO: is that across the full platform or specifically for dedicated inference endpoints that process payment flows? We may propose different tiers in the contract.
3) Please confirm whether your compliance team accepts our standard incident report template (link below) or if you need a custom form.

We plan to include these answers in the PO/contract appendix. If it's easier, happy to hop on a 15-min call today at 4pm ET to lock the last items.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0124

Related: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cACME-SLA
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SLA & Support Onboarding — initial checklist and escalation contacts

Marissa —

Quick clarifications: 
- P1 after-hours: yes, Daniel is on-call but we also use PagerDuty escalation to the cloud-ops rotation; I added the PagerDuty escalation ID to the attached onboarding form and signed it.
- 99.95% SLO: applies to dedicated inference endpoints handling payment-critical traffic (we can mark payment flows in the appendix).
- Incident template: we reviewed your standard template and it works for us; I attached a signed onboarding form (signed-onboarding-form-acme.pdf) with the confirmation and PagerDuty details.

If you want to add the appendix language to the PO we can circulate a redline later today. Otherwise this should be sufficient for procurement to proceed with vendor setup.

Thanks —
Daniel
Head of Cloud Operations | Acme Retail

Attachments: signed-onboarding-form-acme.pdf (application/pdf)
